subject.title: fix(nvidia): sync recommended models with featured catalog

question: Should OpenClaw accept this NVIDIA catalog split where new setup and picker surfaces expose only the seven current featured models while five shipped older refs remain available only by exact reference in the full compatibility catalog?
rationale: The code and proof support the behavior, but it is an intentional compatibility-sensitive provider/catalog policy change and the PR has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Accept The Catalog Split
options.body: Merge after maintainer/provider-owner sign-off because the PR retains shipped exact refs while aligning new choices to NVIDIA's current featured feed.

options.title: Keep Deprecated Rows Selectable
options.body: Ask for a patch that preserves older shipped refs in picker/onboarding surfaces if maintainers want visibility compatibility as well as exact-reference compatibility.

options.title: Pause For Provider Policy
options.body: Hold the PR if the owner wants a broader policy for deprecated live-feed rows before changing user-facing selection behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept The Catalog Split
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer/provider-owner sign-off because the PR retains shipped exact refs while aligning new choices to NVIDIA's current featured feed.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is a compatibility-sensitive provider/catalog boundary choice, and steipete has adjacent provider SDK and extension-boundary ownership history.
